decisions.reason: The Magento 2 shop template costs little to maintain and still supports shop-hosting customers, but templates age quickly, so withdrawal is a real possibility.
The responsive website template is close to the core offer and helps agencies start projects, though it may be superseded by newer templates.
The version management tool is a strategic platform feature that reduces developers' recurring work and fits the firm's tool-driven agency focus.
Scalable agency hosting is the firm's flagship and core direction, so it will be developed further rather than withdrawn.
